metadata.description: Institutional open-source intellectual property and license compatibility audit

MIT.terms: Allows commercial use, modification, distribution, sublicensing, and private use. Requires preserving original copyright notice.
MIT.governance_rule: Retain attribution and copyright notices in third-party attribution documentation.

Apache-2.0.terms: Allows commercial use, modification, and distribution. Includes express patent rights grant. Requires attribution and notice of modifications.
Apache-2.0.governance_rule: State changes clearly in source headers and include original Apache-2.0 NOTICE file.

LGPL-3.0.terms: Weak copyleft. Modifications to LGPL library files must remain LGPL. Calling LGPL library via public API/wrapper does not infect host software.
LGPL-3.0.governance_rule: Do not copy NautilusTrader Rust/Cython source files directly into our platform. Reimplement mathematical mechanisms independently in clean-room Python/NumPy.

GPL-3.0.terms: Strong copyleft. Incorporating GPL-3.0 source code into our codebase would legally force the entire crypto-platform repository to become GPL-3.0.
GPL-3.0.governance_rule: STRICT ZERO-COPY POLICY. Extract mathematical definitions, architectural design patterns, and algorithmic logic only. Write 100% original, independent Python implementations.

Commercial_Closed_Source.governance_rule: Strictly prohibit any use of unauthenticated proprietary code.
